method: Native IDBObjectStore.add throws a deterministic simulated QuotaExceededError only for the restored revision in the custom snapshots store, after earlier writes in that transaction. Actual IDB abort preserves the old current/snapshot/resource rows; the separately committed protection point, restored memory and monotonic undo/redo survive. Retry saves the latest undo branch, then redo persists and reopens. This is not real quota exhaustion.
